latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the find-skills skill.

- Helps users discover and install agent skills based on queries like "how do I do X?" or interest in new capabilities.
- Provides guidance on using the Skills CLI (`npx skills`) to search for, add, check, and update skills.
- Suggests relevant skill categories and practical search tips.
- Includes example command usage and response templates for assisting users.
- Offers fallback options when no relevant skills are found, including direct help or creating a new skill.
